```{r Step 0: Set-up, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# External Job Quality Measures + GSS Merge
# ============================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Merge industry-year measures of objective job quality
#   to individual GSS respondents.
#
# External sources:
#   1. CPS ASEC adjusted industry wage premium
#   2. BLS ECEC benefits
#   3. BLS ECEC wages and salaries
#   4. BLS JOLTS employment stability
#   5. Census QWI earnings volatility
#
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gssr)
```


```{r Step 1: Data Ingestion, include=TRUE}
gss_all <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "GSS_Data_Cleaned", "gss_clean_2000_2024.csv"))
wage_premiums <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "IPUMS_CPS", "industry_wage_premium_2000_2025_n25.csv"))
ecec_benefits <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "BLS_ECEC", "ecec_benefits_industry_annual_2004_2024.csv"))
ecec_wages <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "BLS_ECEC", "ecec_wages_industry_annual_2004_2024.csv"))
jolts_turnover <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "BLS_JOLTS", "jolts_industry_annual_2000_2024.csv"))
qwi_earnings <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "QWI", "qwi_sector_earnings_raw_2000_2024.csv"))
qwi_earnings_michigan <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "QWI", "Michigan_QWIData_2001_2021.csv"))

```

```{r Step 2: Diagnostics for QWI, include=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QWI earnings data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Basic diagnostic
qwi_earnings %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_states = n_distinct(state),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry)
  )


qwi_earnings %>%
  distinct(state) %>%
  arrange(state)

# Specifically check Michigan
qwi_earnings %>%
  filter(state == "26") %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ============================================================
# Standardize Michigan state FIPS and append to QWI earnings
# ============================================================

qwi_earnings_michigan <- qwi_earnings_michigan %>%
  mutate(
    state = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(state))
  )

# Check
qwi_earnings_michigan %>%
  distinct(state)

# Should return:
# "26"


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Append Michigan
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qwi_earnings_complete <- bind_rows(
  qwi_earnings,
  qwi_earnings_michigan
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check for duplicate state-industry-quarter observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qwi_earnings_complete %>%
  count(state, year, quarter, industry) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# ============================================================
# Verify state coverage
# ============================================================

qwi_earnings_complete %>%
  count(state) %>%
  arrange(state)


# Overall coverage
qwi_earnings_complete %>%
  summarise(
    n_states = n_distinct(state),
    n_rows = n()
  )


# Michigan coverage specifically
qwi_earnings_complete %>%
  filter(state == "26") %>%
  summarise(
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year)),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year)),
    n_quarters = n_distinct(
      paste(year, quarter)
    ),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry)
  )

qwi_earnings_complete %>% 
  filter(state == "26") %>% 
  summarise( 
  min_year = min(as.numeric(year)), 
  max_year = max(as.numeric(year)), 
  n_quarters = n_distinct( paste(year, quarter) ), 
  n_industries = n_distinct(industry) 
  )
```


```{r Step 3: Aggregating QWI Earnings to IndustryXYear, include=TRUE}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare state-level QWI data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qwi_earnings_complete_clean <- qwi_earnings_complete %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    quarter = as.integer(quarter),
    EarnS = as.numeric(EarnS),
    EmpS = as.numeric(EmpS),
    state = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(state))
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# National industry-quarter aggregation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qwi_earnings_national <- qwi_earnings_complete_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(EarnS),
    !is.na(EmpS),
    EmpS > 0,
    EarnS > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    quarter,
    industry
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    
    # Employment-weighted average earnings
    earnings_national = weighted.mean(
      EarnS,
      w = EmpS,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Total employment represented by valid observations
    employment_covered = sum(
      EmpS,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Number of states contributing
    n_states = n_distinct(state),
    
    # Number of state-industry observations contributing
    n_state_observations = n(),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    quarter,
    industry
  )

# ============================================================
# National QWI coverage diagnostics
# ============================================================

# Overall
qwi_earnings_national %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry),
    min_year = min(year),
    max_year = max(year),
    n_quarters = n_distinct(
      paste(year, quarter)
    )
  )


# Observations by year
qwi_earnings_national %>%
  count(year) %>%
  arrange(year)


# Observations by quarter
qwi_earnings_national %>%
  count(year, quarter) %>%
  arrange(year, quarter)


# States contributing by quarter
qwi_earnings_national %>%
  group_by(year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    min_states = min(n_states),
    median_states = median(n_states),
    max_states = max(n_states),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, quarter)

qwi_earnings_national %>%
  count(year, quarter, name = "n_industries") %>%
  arrange(year, quarter)


qwi_earnings_national %>%
  summarise(
    min_earnings = min(earnings_national, na.rm = TRUE),
    p1 = quantile(earnings_national, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(earnings_national, na.rm = TRUE),
    p99 = quantile(earnings_national, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_earnings = max(earnings_national, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r Step 4, Creating Volatility Measures, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# QWI: Quarter-to-quarter earnings changes
# ============================================================

qwi_earnings_changes <- qwi_earnings_national %>%
  arrange(
    industry,
    year,
    quarter
  ) %>%
  group_by(industry) %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_index = year * 4 + quarter,

    previous_quarter_index = lag(quarter_index),

    previous_earnings = lag(earnings_national),

    log_earnings_change = if_else(
      quarter_index == previous_quarter_index + 1 &
        !is.na(previous_earnings) &
        previous_earnings > 0 &
        earnings_national > 0,
      log(earnings_national) - log(previous_earnings),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

qwi_earnings_changes %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_valid_changes = sum(!is.na(log_earnings_change)),
    min_change = min(log_earnings_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    p1 = quantile(log_earnings_change, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(log_earnings_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    p99 = quantile(log_earnings_change, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_change = max(log_earnings_change, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

qwi_earnings_changes %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid_changes = sum(!is.na(log_earnings_change)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)



# ============================================================
# QWI: Rolling four-quarter earnings volatility
# ============================================================

library(slider)

qwi_earnings_volatility <- qwi_earnings_changes %>%
  arrange(
    industry,
    year,
    quarter
  ) %>%
  group_by(industry) %>%
  mutate(
    earnings_volatility_4q = slide_dbl(
      log_earnings_change,
      .f = ~ {
        if (sum(!is.na(.x)) < 4) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          sd(.x, na.rm = FALSE)
        }
      },
      .before = 3,
      .complete = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


qwi_earnings_volatility %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_valid_volatility = sum(
      !is.na(earnings_volatility_4q)
    ),
    min_volatility = min(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    p1 = quantile(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      0.01,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median = median(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    p99 = quantile(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      0.99,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_volatility = max(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


qwi_earnings_volatility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(earnings_volatility_4q)
  ) %>%
  group_by(industry) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year),
    first_quarter = min(
      quarter[
        year == first_year
      ]
    ),
    last_year = max(year),
    last_quarter = max(
      quarter[
        year == last_year
      ]
    ),
    n_valid = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

qwi_earnings_volatility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(earnings_volatility_4q)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    quarter,
    industry
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    quarter,
    industry,
    earnings_volatility_4q
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# ============================================================
# QWI: Annual industry earnings volatility
# ============================================================

qwi_earnings_volatility_annual <- qwi_earnings_volatility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(earnings_volatility_4q)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    industry
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    earnings_volatility = mean(
      earnings_volatility_4q,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_quarters = n(),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    industry
  )


# ============================================================
# Annual volatility coverage
# ============================================================

# Number of industries per year
qwi_earnings_volatility_annual %>%
  count(year, name = "n_industries") %>%
  arrange(year)


# Number of quarterly observations contributing to each year
qwi_earnings_volatility_annual %>%
  count(n_quarters, name = "n_industry_years") %>%
  arrange(n_quarters)


# Overall summary
qwi_earnings_volatility_annual %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry),
    min_year = min(year),
    max_year = max(year),
    min_quarters = min(n_quarters),
    median_quarters = median(n_quarters),
    max_quarters = max(n_quarters)
  )


# ============================================================
# Reverse Code Volatility Measure
# ============================================================
 qwi_earnings_volatility_annual <- qwi_earnings_volatility_annual %>% 
  mutate( 
    earnings_stability_reverse = -earnings_volatility 
    ) 

qwi_earnings_volatility_annual %>% select( 
  year, industry, earnings_volatility, earnings_stability_reverse 
  ) %>% slice_head(n = 20)


#Save Volatility Measures as Dataset

# Annual industry-year measure
saveRDS(
  qwi_earnings_volatility_annual,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "QWI",
    "qwi_earnings_volatility_industry_annual_2001_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  qwi_earnings_volatility_annual,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "QWI",
    "qwi_earnings_volatility_industry_annual_2001_2024.csv"
  )
)


# Quarterly intermediate measure
saveRDS(
  qwi_earnings_volatility,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "QWI",
    "qwi_earnings_volatility_industry_quarterly_2001_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  qwi_earnings_volatility,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "QWI",
    "qwi_earnings_volatility_industry_quarterly_2001_2024.csv"
  )
)

```
